_about: H. B. Swete’s footnotes to his printed text: the readings of the other great codices (A Alexandrinus, B Vaticanus, ℵ Sinaiticus, and others where they survive) and later hands. "at" is the verse where a page’s footnotes stand in the digital text, usually at the end of the page they belong to; the verse numbers are inside each note, and a page the digital text lacks has none.
